_comment: MCP configuration for the GitHub Copilot CLOUD AGENT (the one
that picks up assigned issues on github.com). NOT for the in-IDE agent.
Cloud-agent schema differences vs VS Code .vscode/mcp.json:
• Each server MUST declare a `tools:` allow-list (e.g. ['*'] or
• No `inputs:` block — secrets come from `env:` only, supplied
through the repo's Copilot agent settings as `COPILOT_MCP_*` vars
• Configured through GitHub.com → Settings → Copilot → Cloud agent;
this file is a reference template, not the source of truth

inputs.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (needs repo, read:org scopes)
